tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a public web page and return it as an image, a PDF or a video of the page scrolling. Needs the user's CurlShot access key (a key is free at https://curlshot.com/register, no card). Uses one screenshot of the monthly quota; failed renders and cache hits are free. The free plan in

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List the device names accepted by the viewport_device argument of take_screenshot (phones, tablets, laptops). Needs no access key and uses no quota.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "take_screenshot" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
